measures.precision_note: Reconciled using exact register-based Census endpoint totals: official 2024 XLS table 1 gives 51,805,547 and the byte-hashed 2025 XLS gives 51,817,499, an exact increase of 11,952 (0.0230708885%). This rounds to +12 thousand and 0.02%; the PDF table reports 0.0% to one decimal. The independently rounded displayed levels (51,817 minus 51,806 thousand) differ by 11 thousand, while the headline expresses the increase as 1만. These are consistent precision presentations, not a data discrepancy.
